## Acknowledgments

CloudCore Networks (Educational Project) is built on the shoulders of giants. We gratefully acknowledge the following open source projects and their contributors.

## Core Technologies

### Quarto
- **Project:** [quarto.org](https://quarto.org/)
- **License:** MIT
- **GitHub:** [github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli)
- **Usage:** Static site generation, markdown processing, and document rendering

### Bootstrap
- **Project:** [getbootstrap.com](https://getbootstrap.com/)
- **License:** MIT
- **GitHub:** [github.com/twbs/bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap)
- **Usage:** CSS framework and responsive design components

### GitHub Pages
- **Project:** [pages.github.com](https://pages.github.com/)
- **License:** GitHub Terms of Service
- **Usage:** Static website hosting and deployment

## JavaScript Libraries

### Lordicon
- **Project:** [lordicon.com](https://lordicon.com/)
- **License:** Free tier with attribution
- **Usage:** Animated icons throughout the site

### Node.js

## Image Resources

### Stock Photography
All profile images are AI-generated or from royalty-free sources:
- Generated using DALL-E and Midjourney
- No real person's likeness is used

### Icons and Graphics
- Lordicon animated icons (with attribution)
- Custom SVG graphics
- Bootstrap Icons (MIT License)

## Fonts

### System Font Stack
Using native system fonts for optimal performance:
- -apple-system (macOS/iOS)
- BlinkMacSystemFont (macOS Chrome)
- Segoe UI (Windows)
- Roboto (Android)
- Helvetica Neue, Arial (fallbacks)

## Contributing

This educational project welcomes contributions. If you'd like to add your project to these credits or contribute to CloudCore:

1. Fork the repository
2. Add your acknowledgment
3. Submit a pull request

## License Compliance

We take open source licenses seriously. If you believe we've used your project incorrectly or without proper attribution, please contact us immediately at the repository issues page.

## How to Give Attribution

If you fork or use this project:

```markdown
Based on CloudCore Networks Educational Project
https://github.com/michael-borck/cloudcore
MIT License - Educational Use
```
